facts.text: Felucia, known as Galush prior to the formation of the Galactic Republic, was a colorful, humid jungle planet located in the Felucia system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Felucia, known as Galush prior to the formation of the Galactic Republic, was a colorful, humid jungle planet located in the Felucia system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: The headquarters of the Commerce Guild, its primary agricultural export was the valuable crop nysillin, which was largely farmed by the native Felucian tribes.

evidence.quote: The headquarters of the Commerce Guild, its primary agricultural export was the valuable crop nysillin, which was largely farmed by the native Felucian tribes.

facts.text: Felucia was a remote world in the Felucia system, overrun with thick, colorful, and humid jungle made up by a unique combination of fungi species.

evidence.quote: Felucia was a remote world in the Felucia system, overrun with thick, colorful, and humid jungle made up by a unique combination of fungi species.

facts.text: The jungle was punctuated with small farming villages populated by the planet's native Felucians, as well as occasional cities, such as the capital, Kway Teow.

evidence.quote: The jungle was punctuated with small farming villages populated by the planet's native Felucians, as well as occasional cities, such as the capital, Kway Teow.

facts.text: Felucia was governed by the Commerce Guild, who represented the planet's corporate interests on the galactic stage.

evidence.quote: Felucia was governed by the Commerce Guild, who represented the planet's corporate interests on the galactic stage.

facts.text: The world was a hotbed of life, and several non-sentient species also inhabited the world, including Gelagrubs, jungle rancors, and tee-muss.

evidence.quote: The world was a hotbed of life, and several non-sentient species also inhabited the world, including Gelagrubs, jungle rancors, and tee-muss.

facts.text: Despite its perceived insignificance, its important location and resources (which included the healing plant nysillin) led to several conflicts both in orbit and on the surface.

evidence.quote: Despite its perceived insignificance, its important location and resources (which included the healing plant nysillin) led to several conflicts both in orbit and on the surface.

facts.text: Felucia was colonized by the Gossam Courivers, whose first expedition arrived around 27,000 BBY, where it was known as Galush up until sometime after the formation of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Felucia was colonized by the Gossam Courivers, whose first expedition arrived around 27,000 BBY, where it was known as Galush up until sometime after the formation of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Seeking to exploit the nysillin resources present on the planet, the Gossams pressured the native Felucian tribes into expanding their farming operations by clearing swaths of jungle, claiming that they shared a common ancestor.

evidence.quote: Seeking to exploit the nysillin resources present on the planet, the Gossams pressured the native Felucian tribes into expanding their farming operations by clearing swaths of jungle, claiming that they shared a common ancestor.

facts.text: The Commerce Guild, a massive galactic conglomerate, came to be headquarted just outside the walled city of Kway Teow.

evidence.quote: The Commerce Guild, a massive galactic conglomerate, came to be headquarted just outside the walled city of Kway Teow.

facts.text: In 60 BBY during the Republic Era, Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn faced trials on Felucia when he entered into a romantic relationship with someone, falling in love and violating the Jedi Code.

facts.text: Felucia was a largely unsettled terrestrial jungle planet in the Felucia system of the Thanium Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Felucia was a largely unsettled terrestrial jungle planet in the Felucia system of the Thanium Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: Located near the junction of the Perlemian Trade Route and Shaltin Tunnels, the world featured a hot and humid atmosphere and significant water resources beneath a surface irradiated by ultraviolet light of the star Felix.

evidence.quote: Located near the junction of the Perlemian Trade Route and Shaltin Tunnels, the world featured a hot and humid atmosphere and significant water resources beneath a surface irradiated by ultraviolet light of the star Felix.

facts.text: Native plant, fungal, and animal life evolved to dominate the environment in a deep symbiotic relationship, causing significant Force energy to permeate the ecosystem.

evidence.quote: Native plant, fungal, and animal life evolved to dominate the environment in a deep symbiotic relationship, causing significant Force energy to permeate the ecosystem.

facts.text: The native species of sentient Felucians developed Force-based tribal societies in subterranean caverns, largely undisturbed by the greater galaxy until 27,000 BBY, when the planet was discovered by Gossam Couriver hyperspace explorers/colonists from Castell.

evidence.quote: The native species of sentient Felucians developed Force-based tribal societies in subterranean caverns, largely undisturbed by the greater galaxy until 27,000 BBY, when the planet was discovered by Gossam Couriver hyperspace explorers/colonists from Castell.

facts.text: After aggressive resistance from the native wildlife indicated that the world would not support large-scale colonies, the new arrivals established hard-fought, scattered resort settlements on the surface.

evidence.quote: After aggressive resistance from the native wildlife indicated that the world would not support large-scale colonies, the new arrivals established hard-fought, scattered resort settlements on the surface.

facts.text: Early populations, comprising only wealthy Gossams and their poor servants, knew the planet as Galuch and retained colonial control over it until around 25,126 BBY, when Xim the Despot absorbed the world into his empire as it expanded throughout the Tion Cluster.

evidence.quote: Early populations, comprising only wealthy Gossams and their poor servants, knew the planet as Galuch and retained colonial control over it until around 25,126 BBY, when Xim the Despot absorbed the world into his empire as it expanded throughout the Tion Cluster.

facts.text: Xim's dominion fell in 25,096 BBY, and although Felucia changed political loyalties throughout the millennia, the world and its meager settlements of mixed-species immigrant laborers were entirely controlled by the Gossam-dominated Commerce Guild by 700 BBY.

evidence.quote: Xim's dominion fell in 25,096 BBY, and although Felucia changed political loyalties throughout the millennia, the world and its meager settlements of mixed-species immigrant laborers were entirely controlled by the Gossam-dominated Commerce Guild by 700 BBY.

facts.text: These small settlements eventually developed into commercially administered cities like Kway Teow, Har Gau, Jiaozi, and Niango, pushing the native jungle-dwelling Felucians to retreat into the wilderness.

evidence.quote: These small settlements eventually developed into commercially administered cities like Kway Teow, Har Gau, Jiaozi, and Niango, pushing the native jungle-dwelling Felucians to retreat into the wilderness.

facts.text: Independent communities of escaped workers, fugitive labor organizers, and Felucian nysillin farmers maintained tenuous communities in the dangerous wilds, but the Commerce Guild retained economic and political control of their world.

evidence.quote: Independent communities of escaped workers, fugitive labor organizers, and Felucian nysillin farmers maintained tenuous communities in the dangerous wilds, but the Commerce Guild retained economic and political control of their world.

facts.text: When the Guild allied with the anti-Galactic Republic Separatist Movement to create the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY, Felucia joined the rebellion movement in the Clone Wars as a Confederate fortress world.

evidence.quote: When the Guild allied with the anti-Galactic Republic Separatist Movement to create the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY, Felucia joined the rebellion movement in the Clone Wars as a Confederate fortress world.

facts.text: Separatist General Grievous set up a blockade of the planet early in the war, which was unsuccessfully challenged by the Grand Army of the Republic around the beginning of the conflict.

evidence.quote: Separatist General Grievous set up a blockade of the planet early in the war, which was unsuccessfully challenged by the Grand Army of the Republic around the beginning of the conflict.

facts.text: The Republic made a more successful second attempt around a year later.

evidence.quote: The Republic made a more successful second attempt around a year later.

evidence.quote: By 19 BBY, the Commerce Guild had once again established its dominance of Felucia and Guild Presidente Shu Mai chose it as her new headquarters and base of military operations.

facts.text: Its tactical significance made it a primary target in the Republic's Outer Rim Sieges, resulting in a bloody months-long battle at the end of the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Its tactical significance made it a primary target in the Republic's Outer Rim Sieges, resulting in a bloody months-long battle at the end of the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: The years of violence traumatized the native ecosystem, pushing its natural energies and Force-sensitive inhabitants towards the dark side.
